hypothesis: An existing fresh bullish intraday stock signal can be used as an unvalidated call-selection trigger. No profitable options edge has been established.

method.contract: one standard 100-share call per order; no adjusted, short or written contracts
method.entry_signal: existing intraday opening-range breakout with VWAP and volume criteria
other_exits: indicative bid loss trigger -30% or profit trigger +50%
method.dne: Only for abnormal expiry-day residual inventory; persist once before request, never blindly repeat an uncertain request; still exit.
method.selection_coverage: All returned eligible standard-chain metadata is archived. Quotes are queried only for a maximum four-contract shortlist per up to three current stock signals. Unqueried contracts are not independently evaluated samples.
method.commitment_note: Four is a conservative lifetime commitment ceiling; retained rejected/canceled/uncertain reservations can result in fewer than four actual fills.

validation.scope: software tests; not live execution or evidence of profitability

evidence.load_policy: next naturally started existing cloud workflow; no hot reload, dispatch or rerun
evidence.evidence_cutoff_basis: Readiness GET completed at 20:20:31 UTC. Software test and published-code evidence verified before generated_at. No market-performance or trading-state snapshot is claimed.

candidate_results.reason: This stage implements and tests a bounded user-authorized pilot; synthetic software tests are not market-performance research or actual FILL executions.

accounting.fill_basis: broker PAPER FILL versions deduplicated by activity identity; cumulative order observations reserve capital but are not additional executions
accounting.lifecycle_basis: OPEXC, OPTRD, OPASN and OPEXP are separate non-trade activity evidence; unexpected lifecycle events pause entries for manual reconciliation

limitations: Indicative quotes are modified reference prices, not executable OPRA quotes.
PAPER executions do not establish live liquidity, spread costs, queue priority or achievable returns.
An existing equity signal does not validate an options strategy; no profitability conclusion is available.
The affordability and freshness filters may produce no trade; cheaper distant strikes are not substituted.
Full premium can be lost. Exits and DNE are not guarantees; extended outages or expiry failure can create residual exercise exposure.
Private exact historical broker inputs are not published, so exact market replay is not publicly reproducible. Synthetic software tests and reviewed source are public.

questions_for_claude.question: Which diagnostics best separate indicative-quote artifacts from PAPER fill behavior? Please keep account scopes and valuation timestamps separate; suggestions are research hypotheses, not execution authorization.
